'''Breakout Squad''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] unit and part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Initially, most of its members were [[Shiny/Legends|shinies]] brought together under the command of the veteran [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]].

==Mission==
===Mission to the Kaliida Nebula===
Before they took up the moniker of Breakout Squad, the group's first mission was to a moon near the Kaliida Nebula<ref name="TCWSM1" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="ERC" /> Its members were dispatched from the Republic ship [[Demolisher (Venator-class)|''Demolisher'']] to sort through the wreckage of the dreaded [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] heavy cruiser [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="TCWSM1" />

===Mission to Kynachi===
Shortly thereafter, they were sent on a secret mission to [[Kynachi]] to discover the true nature of the exotic circuitry that was discovered among the debris from the ''Malevolence''. 11 Clone Troopers, two pilots, Captain Lock, Jedi Master Ring-Sol Ambase was assigned to the mission with Nuru Kungurama joining in secret. The ship was destroyed upon arrival and Master Ambase was captured. Eventually, the Kungurama led the surviving members to destroy a CIS factory and rescued three clones. It was on Kynachi where Breakout Squad received orders from Palpatine to make the trip to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. It was also at this time that the chancellor christened the group to Breakout Squad.<ref name="TCWSM1" />

===Meeting with the Chiss===
After Kynachi, the survivors left with Captain [[Lalo Gunn]] on her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Hasty Harpy]]'' to go to the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]' [[Ifpe'a|Defense Force Station Ifpe'a]] to meet with [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Sev'eere'nuruodo]]. The station was attacked by a Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Umbrag]] and destroyed. When the ''Hasty Harpy'' made its escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], it came out in a [[Black Hole sector]]. Breakout Squad joined with [[Hethra Mcgrrrr/Legends|Hethra Mcgrrrr's]] [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Pirates]] and were able to escape the "cursed" region using an [[Infinity Gate]].<ref name="TCWSM2" />

===Mission to Vaced===
When Breakout Squad was returning to Coruscant, Chancellor Palpatine contacted them and asked them to [[Mission to Vaced|divert]] to [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] to meet [[Langu Sommilor]], Kynachi's [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] and escort him to Coruscant. On Vaced, the Commissioner was [[Sniper/Legends|sniped]] by a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] member and killed. Kungurama chased after the sniper, and after a skirmish in which the ''Hasty Harpy'' was destroyed, the sniper was believed dead. The [[Swooper/Legends|swoop biker]] [[Gizman|Gizz]] helped Kungurama and Breakout Squad saved him from the authorities on Vaced. Kungurama then followed an [[Imagecaster/Legends|imagecaster]] to [[Bilbringi Depot]]. There Breakout Squad liberated the facility from Overseer Umbrag. The Aristocra then arrived and told the Jedi about a suspected conspiracy against the Republic. Master Ambase then appeared and destroyed Sev'eere'nuruodo's ship.<ref name="TCWSM3" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] arrived to assist in the cleanup, and they discovered the real Langu Sommilor was still alive.<ref name="TCWSM4">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>

===Showdown on Coruscant===
Breakout Squad then returned to Coruscant. Along with Master [[Harro Kelpura]], Breakout Squad investigated a break-in in Kelpura's lab in [[Dacho District]]. Ambase thought Kungurama had fallen to the dark side and dueled with him before Ambase collapsed. Afterward, Kungurama was promoted to the full-time commander of Breakout Squad, and the group was assigned to investigate the disappearance of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Spice Siren/Legends|''Spice Siren'']].<ref name="TCWSM4" />

===Strange alliances===
Breakout Squad's next mission was assigned by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. The squad was sent to [[Affa/Legends|Affa]] to escort [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] freighters. When they arrived, they found a massacre. General Fisto then arrived, and Breakout Squad escorted the freighters to [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], and [[Skirmish at the Fondor Shipyards|defeated]] the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate's]] [[Dool Pundar]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleship]]. On Fondor, Giz met a blind [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], [[Kuvuta Pindi]]. Kungurama agreed to escort her and her orphaned [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] to the placement center on [[Foless/Legends|Foless]]. Once on Foless, Kungurama realized that Pindi was in league with Pundar and Breakout Squad pursued her. Pundar was captured and Pindi was killed. Breakout Squad then returned to Coruscant.<ref name="Strange Allies" />
